name: Acceptance suite-3 test 91b - cross-account PassRole target coexisting with a bare * resource
note: IAM-1005 near-miss (F1 regression guard): iam:PassRole to a FOREIGN-account role (999900001111) BUT the same statement ALSO grants Resource "*", analyzed with subject account 123456789012. Unlike test 91, the bare "*" lets the principal pass a role in its OWN account (123456789012) to EC2 - a fully viable, wildcard-broad, critical same-account path. The cross-account account-mismatch downgrade must NOT fire here (it would understate the blast radius): severity stays critical, no accountMismatch metadata, and NO 'NOT a viable direct ... across accounts' assertion.
